ModMetaData.name: RimWorld Upscaler (Preview)
ModMetaData.author: FluffyBacon
ModMetaData.description:
Render the colony view at a configurable resolution, then scale it using AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1 (EASU and RCAS) or filtered resizing. RimWorld's interface is drawn at the normal display resolution.
Early Windows / DirectX 11 preview. Enable it under Options > Mod options > RimWorld Upscaler. Includes performance, native, and supersampling presets, sharpening, an optional FPS cap, a status overlay, safe native-rendering fallback, and Ctrl+F8 to switch back to native rendering.
This is spatial FSR 1, not DLSS, temporal FSR, or frame generation. It changes rendering, not simulation speed. Benefits depend on the GPU workload; reducing resolution may not improve a CPU-limited colony. Compatibility and image quality need testing with your mod list.
